note: Passages of the 2026 finance law: local authorities appear in tax provisions (the Contribution Foncière Unique levied for them, exemptions), in 52.7 billion FCFA of revenue levied for them in 2026 (29.1 billion in 2025), a 20.7 billion FCFA subsidy line, the 'Gestion des collectivités locales' programme (28.3 billion FCFA) and the special account for water and electricity in local authorities. No line names ICT, a network or the connection of local government offices; the universal-service special account for electronic communications is only renewed by name.
